name: @tellma/locale-ar
description: Arabic locale pack for Tellma distributions — library strings (Transloco scope) plus the self-hosted Noto Sans Arabic font subset.

Born at 0.41 KB measured: provideTellmaLocaleAr and tmArabic, which loads the strings entry point with import().
budgetNotes../strings: Born at 6.39 KB measured: the component library's Arabic and the platform's Arabic table. An app loads it on the first switch to Arabic, never in its initial bundle. Kept at 7 for the launcher's core sections and My settings entries with their search synonyms: +0.20 KB (6.47 before and 6.67 after on a base without the platform's later strings), within the ceiling. The weight is the Arabic of the Analysis and Administration sections and of the four My settings sections, and the launcher's Arabic synonyms of three of them.
budgetNotes._: Ceilings are ratchets. Any raise belongs here with its reason; a raise with no note is a bug.
